name: Siegfried Mureşan, Carla Tavares - Après le § 121 - Am 41
title: INTERIM REPORT on the proposal for a Council regulation laying down the Multiannual Financial Framework for the years 2028 to 2034
part_text: 55h. Is of the view that cross-border IT tools and infrastructure require sustained multi-year financing, as digital case management systems, e-evidence tools, e-filing, eID integration, videoconferencing, and interoperability frameworks require both operational expenditure and capital expenditure;
